Fantastic!!!
Jun 2025 • Couples
Gerne! Hier ist eine grobe, aber natürlich klingende englische Übersetzung deiner Google-Bewertung:

⸻

We had a wonderful and truly delicious evening at this fantastic restaurant. The team is incredibly dedicated. The French dishes come with a modern, international twist. Even if you’re used to dining at Michelin-starred restaurants around the world, you’ll still find yourself pleasantly surprised here.

The wine list is outstanding, and the service is exceptionally good and very attentive. Even by international standards, the evening was something special. We sat at the counter, which was a lot of fun — watching the young team in action was a great experience. Every movement was calm and professional. Seeing all the dishes being grilled or cooked over open fire was truly something unique.

We can recommend this restaurant 100%.

By Vietnamese standards, it’s definitely expensive — not compared to global prices, but for Vietnam, yes. Still, it’s absolutely worth it. It can easily hold its own on an international level.

Totally worth it!
Thank you so much, dear Esta team!

Inventive menu; warm and friendly staff
Dec 2023 • Couples
We had a wonderful experience at Esta. The hospitality was warm and welcoming with the interior design of the space still being chic and cool.
It was fun to sit at the chef’s counter and see the kitchen preparing the dishes. The whole staff was so kind.

The food was all wonderful and very inventive. We got the full menu (8 courses), with the wine pairing. Every dish was delicious. The portions were ample for tasting menu - come very hungry. 

I would recommend to the staff to reiterate if there are any allergies for their guests. We had mentioned a dairy allergy upon booking, and while the staff recognized this for the first couple dishes with substitutes, later on in the dinner I was presented with ice cream and some cream/dairy-based sides or sauces. It didn’t lessen my experience, but if someone has a more severe allergy, you might want to triple check with the chef.

For Americans, the price/value for such a high-quality tasting menu was phenomenal, though this restaurant is significantly more expensive than almost any other restaurant in the city (but if you are booking this kind of dinner, you are probably expecting that anyway).

Overall, I would highly recommend Esta if you are in Ho Chi Minh City!

Best place in Saigon for a special moment
Aug 2022 • Friends
It is from far the best place i ever tried in Ho Chi Minh. The Level of cooking is very high, they should have a Star Michelin. I was in Saigon 3 years ago, and could taste the kitchen of the chef in „Queens“ at this time. At the queens it was more about best Meat. Today at ESTA the Menu has much more diversity. Everything is smoked. Everything is perfectly Cooked, combinated, we find only Finesse meals. Finest of all Saigon. The wine choice is perfectly choose in combination with the meals. I was there on 17 th. August 2022. My only regrets is that they could Not host me and my Family on 18. August for a family fest. Not easy to book here when you are around 16 people as the room not big enough is. At least i could enjoy it the day before with 2 friends.
